golden_trace.dtype_out: bf16 at contract cast points; fp32 logits/logp/lse
golden_trace.reduction_order: rows: adjacent-pair halving then sequential (tree_sum_last); attention: 64-key blocks ascending from floor(max(0,p-W+1)/64), fixed trees over D=128 and 64 keys, p→bf16 before PV; row-parallel GEMM: 8 K-chunks ((0+1)+(2+3))+((4+5)+(6+7)); lm_head: 8 vocab tiles, same tree over (M,S)

gemm_trace.reduction_order: K split into 8 consecutive chunks [c*K/8, (c+1)*K/8); per chunk a dependent chain of bf16 mma.sync.m16n8k16 (fp32 accumulate, starting at +0) in ascending k over >= 2 BLOCK_K iterations; chunk partials combined in registers as fp32 IEEE adds in the fixed tree ((0+1)+(2+3))+((4+5)+(6+7)); single rounding to dtype_out at the store
gemm_trace.k_rule: K % 256 == 0 required (8 chunks x 32); otherwise ValueError, unless the caller passes ragged_k=True (backward reductions only: dW over tokens, dA over output features): K_pad = roundup(K, 256), 8 chunks of K_pad/8, columns >= K masked to zero
gemm_trace.block_k_rule: BLOCK_K = largest of (64, 32, 16) with chunk_len % BLOCK_K == 0 and chunk_len / BLOCK_K >= 2 (64 for every model forward shape; 16 for 32-wide chunks, 32 for 64-wide chunks); a 1-iteration chunk would let Triton fold the tree adds into the MMA chain, with >= 2 iterations BLOCK_K does not change the bits
gemm_trace.da_chunk_rule: reduction over N with the canonical rule (8 chunks of N/8); N % 256 != 0 (never for the model) uses N_pad = roundup(N, 256) with masked columns (batch-invariant); column-parallel TP: each rank reduces its 8/t chunks to an fp32 sub-tree partial, partials combined in the canonical tree, one rounding
gemm_trace.dw_chunk_rule: reduction over the M tokens: M_pad = roundup(M, 256), 8 chunks of M_pad/8 rows, rows >= M masked to zero (repeatable; not batch-invariant by design)
gemm_trace.grad_cast: dY -> bf16 once (round-to-nearest-even) before the backward GEMMs, for bf16 and fp32 outputs alike; dA and dW are rounded once to the operand dtype
gemm_trace.tree_ir_guard: enabled: TTGIR of every compiled variant must hold NUM_CHUNKS-1 fp32 tree adds
